events.text: Operation of the all-seat reserved train Haijima Liner using the Seibu 40000 series EMU was started.
events.subject: self
events.quote: operation of the all-seat reserved train Haijima Liner using the Seibu 40000 series EMU has been started from March 2018

events.text: The initial Kawagoe Railway route opened between Kokubunji and Kumegawa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The initial Kawagoe Railway route opened between Kokubunji and Kumegawa in 1894

events.text: Its northward extension to Kawagoe, the first part of what is now the Seibu Shinjuku Line, opened.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Its northward extension to Kawagoe , the first part of what is now the Seibu Shinjuku Line , opened in 1895

events.text: The Kawagoe Railway became part of the Seibu Railway.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Kawagoe Railway became part of the Seibu Railway

events.text: Seibu Railway built its new dual track, electrified Murayama Line between Takadanobaba Station and Higashi-Murayama Station.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1927 , Seibu Railway built its new dual track , electrified at 1,500 V DC , Murayama Line

events.text: The rest of the line was electrified at the same time.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The rest of the line was electrified at the same time .

events.text: The Higashi-Murayama to Tokorozawa section was double-tracked.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Higashi-Murayama to Tokorozawa section was double-tracked between 1950 and 1958

events.text: The double-tracking of the Higashi-Murayama to Tokorozawa section ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Higashi-Murayama to Tokorozawa section was double-tracked between 1950 and 1958

events.text: The Tokorozawa to Irimagawa section was double-tracked.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with the Tokorozawa to Irimagawa section double-tracked between 1967 and 1975

events.text: The double-tracking of the Tokorozawa to Irimagawa section ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with the Tokorozawa to Irimagawa section double-tracked between 1967 and 1975

events.text: The rest of the line was double-tracked.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The rest of the line ( except for the section between the Wakita Junction and Hon-Kawagoe Station ) was double-tracked between 1980 and 1991

events.text: The double-tracking of the rest of the line ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was double-tracked between 1980 and 1991

events.text: A dual-track extension from Takadanobaba to Seibu-Shinjuku Station was completed.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1952 , a dual-track extension from Takadanobaba to Seibu-Shinjuku Station was completed

events.text: The line was renamed the Shinjuku Line, integrating the Murayama Line and the northern section of the Kawagoe Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At this time the line was renamed the Shinjuku Line

events.text: Seibu-Shinjuku Station was expanded to include a high-rise hotel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Seibu-Shinjuku Station was expanded to include a high-rise hotel in 1977

events.text: Seibu drew up a plan to build an underground line for express trains between Seibu-Shinjuku and Kami-Shakujii.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the 1980s , Seibu drew up a plan to build an underground line for express trains

events.text: The plan was indefinitely postponed due to costs and a decline in passenger ridership.
events.subject: self
events.quote: This plan was indefinitely postponed in 1995 due to costs

events.text: Seibu was a bidder to acquire the former JR freight terminal site.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Seibu was also a bidder to acquire the former JR freight terminal site in 1989

events.text: The limited-stop services were abolished from the start of the revised timetable.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From the start of the revised timetable on 30 June 2012 , the limited-stop services were abolished .

events.text: Station numbering was introduced on all Seibu Railway lines during fiscal 2012.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Station numbering was introduced on all Seibu Railway lines during fiscal 2012

events.text: The limited-stop was reinstated for weekend and holiday services from the timetable revision.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From the timetable revision on 14 March 2020 , the limited-stop was reinstated for weekend and holiday services .
